checks.evidence: Devre dışı bırakma eşiğine ulaşıldığında tüm kimlik doğrulayıcıların devre dışı bırakılması, step 1-2: failed attempts with wrong password and wrong 2FA up to the threshold, then correct password and correct 2FA is refused because the authenticators are disabled.

invented: Threshold value of 5 stated as defined in §14 (the requirement does not give a value)
Admin panel/API query of authenticator status (step 3 of first test)
Third test expects the password to stay enabled when only the second factor fails, and that only the second factor is disabled; this is not stated in the requirement
